title: Scaling and Cross-Simulation Generalization of Graph Neural Networks for Cosmic-Web Classification in CAMELS
abstract: arXiv:2611.34332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph-based methods can classify galaxies by their dark-matter cosmic-web environments, but reliability beyond development simulations remains uncertain. Galaxy-formation models alter tracer populations and spatial distributions, potentially shifting graph features. We test how graph neural networks scale with independent training realizations and transfer across hydrodynamical simulations. Using the $z=0$ CAMELS IllustrisTNG, SIMBA and Astrid suites, we label galaxies with $M_\star>10^9\,M_\odot$ as void, sheet, filament or knot from the smoothed cold-dark-matter density field. We represent their spatial distributions as periodic Delaunay graphs with ten geometric descriptors. We compare a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and five graph neural networks (GNNs), including a local graph Transformer, under realization-grouped evaluation. Learning curves increase training data from 10 to 100 realizations, with validation and test boxes fixed. W

translated_title: CAMELS宇宙网分类中图神经网络的规模化与跨模拟泛化研究
translated_abstract: 基于图的方法可以根据星系所处的暗物质宇宙网环境对星系进行分类，但其超越开发模拟之外的可靠性仍不确定。星系形成模型会改变示踪天体的数量与空间分布，可能导致图特征发生偏移。我们测试了图神经网络如何随独立训练样本数的增加而扩展，以及如何在不同流体动力学模拟之间迁移。利用z=0的CAMELS IllustrisTNG、SIMBA和Astrid模拟套件，我们根据平滑后的冷暗物质密度场，将质量大于10^9太阳质量的星系标记为空洞、薄片、纤维或节点四类环境。我们将其空间分布表示为带有十个几何描述量的周期性Delaunay图。在按样本组划分的评估下，我们比较了一个多层感知机（MLP）和五种图神经网络（GNN），其中包括一个局部图Transformer。学习曲线将训练数据从10个独立样本逐步增加到100个，同时保持验证与测试盒固定不变。
tldr: 本研究系统评估了图神经网络在CAMELS多套流体动力学模拟中进行宇宙网环境分类时，随训练样本规模扩展的性能变化规律及其跨模拟泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates how graph neural networks scale with independent training realizations and generalize across hydrodynamical simulations for cosmic-web classification of galaxies in the CAMELS suites.
